cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could you leave quiz night for your sister's first exhibition opening?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm captain. They'll think I've abandoned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Tell them your sister needs you. I'd like that to outrank geography.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come after round one, but tell them it's for me. I want to rank above geography, not below a headache.

mechanism: A uses expert delegation and accurate handover language to make B leave quiz duty for A exhibition and publicly acknowledge the sibling relationship as the reason.
confusable: Simple attendance seeking would accept a headache excuse; A needs the changed commitment to demonstrate choosing the relationship.
comparison: Lunch alternative buys a private diary slot; exhibition alternative seeks an honest public change of team responsibility for family.
seedUse: Quiz captain, sister opening and headache excuse derive from D35-b; S03 contributes proper delegation and reason-giving corrections.
